title: Keep recreational water activities safe
what: As a business providing recreational water activities (such as diving or snorkelling), ensure so far as is reasonably practicable that participants' health and safety are not put at risk.

laws.title: Safety in Recreational Water Activities Act 2011 (Qld)

sources.title: Safety in Recreational Water Activities Act 2011 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person conducting a business or undertaking that provides recreational water activities must ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the health and safety of persons for whom the activities are provided are not put at risk by the provision of the recreational water activity

administration.who: Regulator under the Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Workplace Health and Safety Queensland)
